title: Tool use cases
description: What a contributor does with the repository's tooling.

entities.name: Check the specification material after a change
entities.description: A contributor who changed the schema, the conformance material or a JSON example in the specification checks that everything still agrees.
entities.goal: Know that the structural material is consistent before the change is pushed.
preconditions: jsonschema 4.18 or later is installed (pip install -r tools/requirements.txt).
The script finds the repository from its own location (ROOT), so it works from any directory.
postconditions: Every check printed ok and the script exited 0, or every failure was printed and it exited 1. Nothing is written.

flow.action: Checks every schema/*.schema.json against Draft 2020-12 and builds a validator for utv-1.0.
Validates the valid and the structurally invalid conformance examples, and every complete UTV example embedded in spec/*.md.
Checks the scenario files' fields and ids, and that spec/FALSEHOODS-MATRIX.md and falsehoods.json list the same ids.
Checks every UTV value in the everyday and text-form fixtures against the schema, that fixture ids are unique, and that named rule bundles exist.
Prints "All structural checks passed." and exits 0.

alternatives.condition: A schema file is not a valid Draft 2020-12 schema, or any JSON file read has a duplicate key.
alternatives.outcome: The script stops with a traceback; no later check runs.

alternatives.condition: A check finds a value accepted or rejected wrongly, or a valid example without utv/1.0.
alternatives.outcome: A FAIL line is printed, the remaining checks still run, and the script exits 1 with the number of failures.

alternatives.condition: The falsehoods matrix and falsehoods.json disagree.
alternatives.outcome: One FAIL line per id missing on either side; exit 1.

entities.name: Update the side-by-side page after changing an example
entities.description: A contributor who changed a UTV-first example test between task markers regenerates docs/side-by-side.md, which CI otherwise rejects.
entities.goal: Keep docs/side-by-side.md showing the code the example tests actually run.
preconditions: The changed tests are in one of the five UTV-first suites named in LANGUAGES.
postconditions: docs/side-by-side.md matches the marked code, and python3 tools/side_by_side.py --check exits 0.

flow.action: Reads each language's UTV-first files in order and collects the dedented code between BEGIN and END markers, per task id.
Lays the tasks out in the order of SECTIONS, one fenced block per language, and writes docs/side-by-side.md.
Commits the regenerated page with the test change (AGENTS.md: CI fails if the page is out of date).

alternatives.condition: A marker is nested, mismatched or never closed.
alternatives.outcome: The script exits naming the file and the marker; the page is not written.

alternatives.condition: A language has not marked one of the tasks.
alternatives.outcome: The page is still written, with the missing language and task listed under a final Missing heading.
